details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** A challenge is delivered with a precise account of an old insult.

**Purpose:** Win publicly and leave a reputation intact.

**Tactics and retreat:** Drive one opponent away from support; retreat rather than accept an ugly crowd fight.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Refuse the chosen ground or expose the sponsor behind the mask.

**Habitat:** City; court · **Communication:** Common and court language

**Loot:** Fine but ordinary melee weapon and 40 coins.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-masked-duelist


**Category:** Mortal · **Role:** Elite striker · **CV:** 24

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Turning blade | Agility | 1 Boon | 4 physical damage. | 6 physical damage. Push 1. | 8 physical damage. Push 2. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 4/6/8

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.25

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.988, O=5.596. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/d67e046466bdd5052360b96ed91861d607091446/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [driving blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/d67e046466bdd5052360b96ed91861d607091446/design/monster-abilities/driving-blow.md), [stalking step](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/d67e046466bdd5052360b96ed91861d607091446/design/monster-abilities/stalking-step.md).
